event: PCE and Q3 GDP came out at 15:30 SAST today; expect fast moves for the next hour. Thu 26 Nov: Thanksgiving, US markets shut. Fri 27 Nov: US stocks close early. Fed decision Wed 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Sliding toward 3,500
bullets.text: COMEX December gold was 3,514.10, down 1.34%, at 15:25 SAST; spot was near 3,531 around 13:00 SAST (spot now UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: PCE just out
bullets.text: One headline says core PCE came in at 3.3% y/y versus 3.2% expected, which would be hawkish for gold (UNVERIFIED, page could not be read).

bullets.title: Hike fully priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch showed a 97.8% chance of a 25 bp Fed hike on 9 December at 14:18 SAST.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 103.9-104.0, close to Monday's 20-month high of 104.59, and the US 10-year yield is about 4.85-4.90%.

bullets.title: Forced selling
bullets.text: Falling tech stocks and the CME margin hike are pushing traders to sell gold to raise cash.

bullets.title: Oversold, not a signal
bullets.text: RSI is near 28-29, so a sharp bounce is possible, but the trend is still down with gold off about 8% in November.

bullets.title: Thin holiday trade
bullets.text: With Thanksgiving on Thursday, liquidity will be thin and moves can be jumpy.
